scope: homepage Pokémon Championship Series section only

interpretationPolicy.fact: Only frozen screenshot regions, live-DOM observations, computed facts, archived source rules, and archived asset identities from Attempt 11 are treated as facts.
interpretationPolicy.interpretation: Intent statements are restricted to the narrowest section, role, viewport endpoint, or interaction state supported by those facts.
interpretationPolicy.recommendation: Implementation and QA guidance is labelled as guidance and does not become an observed source fact.
prohibitions: Do not infer a global brand palette from colors embedded in the official Championship image.
Do not turn the white page canvas into opaque white column or child backgrounds.
Do not promote the focus outline blue to a decorative or brand-accent color.
Do not infer motion duration from capture order or continuous-scroll frame spacing.
Do not use any frozen source screenshot or screenshot crop as a runtime asset.

observedFacts: The section sits between Pokémon TCG Pocket and Play! Pokémon in the rendered homepage flow.
A neutral white page canvas carries a transparent section structure, centered copy, one CTA, and one square official event image.
At 1440px, copy and image have equal 720px fields; at 390px, the same image becomes the first full-width block and copy follows.
The official image carries the event-specific color and identity; the section UI observed outside the image stays white, near-black, and interaction-gold.
The single Learn more CTA is black by default, gold on settled pointer hover, and black with an outline on keyboard focus.
visualIntent.interpretation: This section gives the official event image equal structural weight to a restrained editorial explanation. Its identity comes from the exact square event asset plus a strict split-to-stack composition; it does not come from spreading the image palette across the surrounding UI.
suitableFor: a single high-salience event or program entry within a longer editorial homepage
a section with one principal square image, one heading, one explanatory paragraph, and one primary outbound CTA
a source-calibration surface that preserves adjacent homepage continuity
notFor: dense card grids, filter bars, forms, tables, or utility screens
full-bleed image overlays or text placed on the Championship image
global page theming derived from the colors inside the event photo

recommendations.text: Verify 1440 and 390 section-local rectangles, background ownership, DOM/visual order, exact asset hash/currentSrc, and all three CTA presentations before QA.
Compare default, settled pointer hover, and keyboard focus independently; a gold focus state is a blocking role expansion.
Reject a held-out proof that only reflows the source responsively, swaps official imagery, or changes labels while preserving the original composition verbatim.
